how.sub: You create the album. Your guests do the rest.

s1.title: Create your album
s1.text: Pick the occasion, name your album and set the date. It takes less than a minute.

s3.title: Guests upload their photos
s3.text: From the browser, no app and no sign-up: they take or pick a photo and send it.

s4.title: Relive the memories
s4.text: Photos land in the album and play live on the big screen as a slideshow.

pricing.title: Simple. One payment.
pricing.sub: Start with a 7-day free trial, no card. If you love the album, activate it once and that’s it.

q1.q: Do I need to install an app?
q1.a: No. You manage the album in the browser and guests join from their phone’s browser by scanning the QR code.

q2.a: They scan the QR code or open the link, take or pick a photo and send it. No sign-up needed.

q3.a: You can still view the album and your photos are kept. New uploads stop until you activate the Full album.

q4.a: The trial is free. The Full album costs €19.99 once: it is not a subscription, it is not monthly and it is not per guest.

q5.q: Do I need a credit card to try it?
q5.a: No, the free trial does not require a credit card.

q6.q: Can I use it for events other than a wedding?
q6.a: Yes: wedding, birthday, christening or any other event. Pick the occasion when you create the album.

q7.a: Only people with the QR code or the link can take part. In the privacy settings you decide whether guests can send photos and whether to show them on the screen.

q8.a: Italian, English, French and Spanish, for you and for your guests.

cta.title: Create your album in a minute
cta.text: Try it free for 7 days. No credit card.
